groups.title: Trenchless
groups.summary: Boring and tunneling that puts pipe underground without opening the surface above it.
groups.intro: As the need to expand or rehabilitate existing infrastructure grows, trenchless construction keeps getting more essential, because it is minimally disruptive to surface activities. HASSCO offers one of the most experienced trenchless construction resumes in the industry and is known for accurate and timely results. Alongside traditional boring and tunneling, we build and run our own in-house trenchless methods and machines for custom underground solutions.
groups.imageAlt: A HASSCO tunnel crossing beneath a railroad, with casing pipe set in the bore pit

about.title: Turnkey specialty construction solutions.
text: HASSCO, LLC is a full-service, multi-disciplined specialty construction company delivering underground and heavy civil solutions across the industrial, commercial and municipal sectors. With over 80 years of collective experience, our team provides innovative, efficient and safety-focused solutions for projects ranging from small-scale installations to complex infrastructure systems.

HASSCO is your single-source specialty contractor, providing the complete package of underground services with the convenience of working with one trusted partner. Five specialized divisions work in alignment, so earthwork, trench shoring, boring, dewatering and surface restoration are handled by one integrated team rather than five separate ones.

Our vision is simple: get the job done right and on time. Through advanced equipment, proven methods and a team built on experience and accountability, we deliver safe, cost-effective solutions while maintaining strong client partnerships. HASSCO is proud of a legacy of excellence built on safety, innovation and results.

facts.heading: Trench shoring systems we install
items: Liner plate — shaft construction and tunneling access, deep excavations, limited access areas
Trench boxes — steel and aluminum shields, rapid installation, stackable for deeper trenches
Beam & plate — linear utility installations, strong lateral soil support, varying depths and widths
Beam & lagging — unstable soils and irregular excavation layouts, common on municipal work
Slide rail systems — deep, narrow excavations, manholes, vaults and structures, minimal surface disruption
Sheet piling — earth retention for high groundwater or surcharge conditions, industrial and marine

facts.heading: Dewatering methods
items: Deep wells — submersible pumps lowering the water table in permeable soils
Wellpoints — a series connected to a header pipe for shallow excavations in sands and silts
Vacuum assisted systems — wellpoints under vacuum pressure for low-permeability soils
Eductor systems — jet eductors using high-pressure water in tight soils

facts.heading: Why dewatering matters in Houston
facts.text: Houston's clay-dominant soils lose strength rapidly when saturated, so engineered dewatering lowers the water table and reduces pore pressure to protect foundations, utilities and adjacent structures, keeps groundwater discharge within TCEQ and local requirements, and cuts the downtime and slip hazards that water intrusion causes.

facts.heading: Hydro excavation work
items: Sensitive excavations and exposure of live lines
Congested, unapproachable or remote excavation at long distances
Track cleaning for retarders, switches, diamonds and other difficult-to-reach places
Oilfield services, location cleaning crews, tank cleaning, rig and pit cleaning

facts.heading: Vacuum truck capability
facts.text: HASSCO states its trucks have the highest airflow in the industry, drawing material 100 feet vertically and up to 1,000 feet from the truck. The hydrovac fleet works with every HASSCO division and is also available at daily rates.
